acceptanceCriteria: Either the fallback is narrowed to the not-a-repository exit, with a test that a permission or other git failure is reported, or a recorded decision says the fallback is intended and the unit stays in unbounded-readers.json with that reason.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

Reported by the V1-0868 lane (2026-10-06), not yet confirmed as a defect. tools/cem-interop-runner/consumer.go:359 treats a failed git rev-parse as standalone mode, so a confined test run whose .git read is refused can pass while the read goes unnoticed, and a real repository can be misreported as standalone. Expected: an error other than not-a-repository is surfaced, or the fallback is documented as intended with its consequence for read-scope measurement.
title: Suspected: cem-interop-runner silently falls back to standalone when git rev-parse is refused, hiding a read under a confined run
